title: Can latent prediction support planning with language actions?
decision: Treat GAR as the central supported mechanism, finish distractor-matched length OOD evaluation, and do not claim qualitative geometry differences until controlled paraphrase, negation, reconstruction, and reproducible visualization analyses are complete.
plain_summary: JEPA performs competitive intent-phrase planning and maintains high-rank representations, but sentence language models currently lead strict success and encode operation identity more linearly; GAR is essential, while length generalization and qualitative geometry remain open.
